mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_token_stat (stat_date, stat_hour, user_id, channel_id, model_name, call_count, success_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, total_cost) SELECT #{statDate} AS stat_date, -1 AS stat_hour, IFNULL(user_id, 0) AS user_id, IFNULL(channel_id, 0) AS channel_id, IFNULL(model_name, '') AS model_name, COUNT(*) AS call_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_count, SUM(prompt_tokens) AS prompt_tokens, SUM(completion_tokens) AS completion_tokens, SUM(total_tokens) AS total_tokens, SUM(cost) AS total_cost FROM t_call_log WHERE DATE(created_at) = #{statDate} GROUP BY user_id, channel_id, model_name ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count = VALUES(call_count), success_count = VALUES(success_count), prompt_tokens = VALUES(prompt_tokens), completion_tokens = VALUES(completion_tokens), total_tokens = VALUES(total_tokens), total_cost = VALUES(total_cost), updated_at = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT model_name AS modelName, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(total_cost) AS totalCost FROM t_token_stat WHERE stat_hour = -1 AND stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND model_name != '' GROUP BY model_name ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT s.model_name AS modelName, SUM(s.total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(s.total_cost) AS totalCost FROM t_token_stat s JOIN t_user u ON s.user_id = u.id AND u.group_status = 0 WHERE s.stat_hour = -1 AND s.stat_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND s.model_name != '' GROUP BY s.model_name ORDER BY totalTokens DESC LIMIT 10
